title: Ang Daigdig Ko'y Ikaw
creator: Efren Reyes
description: A romantic comedy in which Roman, a truck driver, crosses paths with Vicky, a runaway heiress. It was the first film to pair Poe with Susan Roces, whom he later married.
subject: Romance; Comedy; With Susan Roces

title: Tanging Ikaw
description: Poe and Susan Roces star together again, in the year of their wedding.
subject: Romance; With Susan Roces

title: Tatak ng Alipin
description: One of the 1970s films that built Poe's image as the underdog who stands up for himself.
subject: Drama

title: Tutubing Kalabaw, Tutubing Karayom
description: Poe plays Berting, a man from the countryside who comes to the rescue of a friend and goes after the people who wronged her. Child star Niño Muhlach co-stars.
subject: Action; Drama

title: Ang Maestro
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe directs himself as Maestro Carpio, a master swordsman bound by a promise to teach only one student.
subject: Action; Directed by FPJ

title: Isang Bala Ka Lang!
description: An action film that was followed by a sequel in 1996.
subject: Action

title: Partida
description: An action film released in 1985.
subject: Action

title: Isa-Isa Lang!
description: Poe plays Carding Briñas in this action film.
subject: Action

title: Kapag Puno Na ang Salop
description: Poe is Sgt. Isagani Guerrero, a policeman. Two sequels followed, in 1989 and 1990.
subject: Action; Lawman roles; Kapag Puno Na ang Salop series

title: Batas sa Aking Kamay
description: A policeman takes the law into his own hands to avenge the killing of his family.
subject: Action; Lawman roles

title: Dito sa Pitong Gatang
creator: Pablo Santiago
description: Poe plays Berting Cayabyab, chairman of Barangay Pitong Gatang in Tondo, who falls for Lambing (Nanette Medved), the chairman of the barangay next door.
subject: Action; Comedy; Romance

title: Walang Matigas na Tinapay sa Mainit na Kape
description: Poe plays Mike Bautista, opposite Alice Dixson and Vandolph.
subject: Comedy; Romance

title: Kahit Butas ng Karayom, Papasukin Ko
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe stars as Daniel and directs. The film won him his second FAMAS Award for Best Director.
subject: Action; Directed by FPJ; FAMAS Best Director

title: Ang Probinsyano
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe plays twin brothers, Ador and Kardo. When one is killed in Manila, the other, a provincial policeman, takes his place. The film was remade in 2015 as a television series.
subject: Action; Lawman roles; Directed by FPJ; Adapted for television

title: Isusumbong Kita sa Tatay Ko...
description: Poe plays Badong Rivera, with Judy Ann Santos co-starring.
subject: Action; Comedy

title: Ang Dalubhasa
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe directs and stars as Dr. Jaime de Guzman. It was one of his last films.
subject: Action; Directed by FPJ

title: Pagbabalik ng Lawin
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe directs and stars as Guiller, who is sold into slavery with his mother after armed men capture their ship and kill his father. He escapes and plots revenge to restore his family's honor. Max Alvarado and Vic Diaz co-star.
subject: Action; Adventure; Directed by FPJ

title: Patayin si... Mediavillo
creator: Armando A. Herrera
description: Poe plays Mediavillo, a police officer hunted by assassins hired by a businessman whose drug-dealer brother died at Mediavillo's hands. Azenith Briones co-stars.
subject: Action; Lawman roles

title: Pepeng Kaliwete
creator: Pablo Santiago
description: Poe plays the title role, a former boxer and left-handed marksman shaped by a hard past. Marianne dela Riva and Paquito Diaz co-star.
subject: Action

title: Ang Padrino
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: A Filipino take on The Godfather. Poe co-wrote, produced and directed, and stars as Emong Sanchez, a respected town elder who settles disputes as the local padrino. It won the FAMAS Awards for Best Picture and Best Director.
subject: Action; Drama; Directed by FPJ; FAMAS Best Director

title: Agila ng Maynila
creator: Pablo Santiago
description: Poe plays Mauro Reyes, the "eagle" of Manila, an ex-policeman who hunts down criminals after the death of his family. It was the top-grossing entry of the 1988 Metro Manila Film Festival.
subject: Action; Lawman roles; Metro Manila Film Festival

title: Ako ang Huhusga
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: The first sequel to Kapag Puno Na ang Salop. Poe returns as Guerrero and directs, as the corrupt Judge Valderama (Eddie Garcia) is freed on a technicality and seeks revenge.
subject: Action; Lawman roles; Directed by FPJ; Kapag Puno Na ang Salop series

title: Callejon 11
creator: Armando A. Herrera
description: Poe plays Daniel, a policeman working undercover on Callejon Street in Manila, befriending its residents to gather evidence against a wealthy businessman suspected of running a syndicate. Berting Labra and Jess Lapid co-star.
subject: Action; Drama; Lawman roles

title: Manedyer... si Kumander!
creator: Pablo Santiago
description: An action comedy in which Poe plays Gener, a mechanic who keeps landing in trouble with his jealous wife, played by Susan Roces, when other women take him for a single man. Janice de Belen co-stars. A sequel followed in 1987.
subject: Action; Comedy; With Susan Roces

title: Pakners
creator: Tony Y. Reyes
description: Poe's last film. He plays Nanding Escalante, a jeepney driver who teams up with Manuel (billiards champion Efren "Bata" Reyes), a man just conned out of his savings, to win their fortune at the pool table.
subject: Action; Comedy; Last film
